They do not prove the latest source unless the commit matches current_evidence.app_source_commit; statuses remain partial/not_run until the exact acceptance method is repeated.

cases.name: Шумный аккаунт
cases.expected: Burst не создаёт бесконечные UI/tasks/фото queues и не теряет edit/delete/auth/TTL; foreground B остаётся отзывчивым.
cases.evidence: At app-source commit e89265c0dda7dc88a7d7a7f75abd5010c25a48c9, TDLibUpdateBuffer adds a hard-bounded overflow reserve: at most one event for each of 20 client lanes, one unrouteable lane, and additional reserved bytes capped at 25% of the primary byte budget. A later audit found that one event larger than byteCapacity could still enter an otherwise empty queue. Fix 6c6fff49d6c43746b3990de178b723d1eaf75172 rejects oversized queue events and closes the receive gateway with an explicit error; the C bridge checks a 16 MiB maximum before copying TDLib's borrowed buffer. Added regression tests cover rejection while empty and fail-closed/send rejection. The exact-source local suite passed 136/136; macOS CI 38395900507 and pinned TDLib/Dev.app workflow 38395900428 succeeded on the same SHA. Instruments, real 20-account burst, queue/task/RSS behavior under load, and native foreground responsiveness remain unverified; acceptance stays partial.

cases.name: Адаптивная геометрия и читаемость экрана входа

cases.method: source-matched native visual review at default and minimum window sizes; dark/light and accessibility contrast checks
cases.evidence: App-source SHA 816bbb4ab2a61817cc3da0780f47219b1f8f52e9 contains a centered adaptive AppKit authentication card and the exact-source pinned TDLib/Dev.app workflow 38407466662 captured its accountless first-run screen in isolated CI. The screenshot was not visually re-reviewed in this checkpoint. Earlier source-matched first-run screen review is historical for 1b3d910. Dark appearance, minimum supported window, code/2FA/QR/registration layouts, high contrast, native VoiceOver and IME remain unverified; actual macOS Keychain persistence and login are not tested. Status stays partial. Current source commit 86855e4599ae4dc9d00274c07331617ddc5b3684 replaces the contradictory sign-in subtitle with a clear statement that NeTelegram is an independent unofficial client using Telegram API/TDLib and has no direct relationship with Telegram Messenger LLP; exact-HEAD AppKit build passed. This validates compilation and copy only, not native visual contrast, dark appearance, VoiceOver, IME, minimum window layout, or live login. Case remains partial.

cases.name: Удаление незавершённого локального входа
cases.expected: Удаляется только профиль без подтверждённого TelegramUserID. Удаление фиксируется до close; рестарт не открывает профиль с pending marker. Ключи и файлы удаляются после TDLib Closed и снятия route; ошибки допускают безопасный повтор. Подтверждённый аккаунт этим действием удалить нельзя.
cases.method: Core failure-injection tests + exact-source native Dev.app UI smoke; no Telegram credentials required
cases.evidence: App source d57d569 adds an explicit “Удалить незавершённый вход…” action, durable unverified-removal marker, identity-association guard, restore exclusion, and retryable Keychain/file/catalogue cleanup after authorizationStateClosed and route removal. Local serial suite passed 134/134, including verified-identity rejection, no-restore while pending, retry after file failure, and retaining files when key deletion fails. Native menu journey and actual TDLib close remain unverified pending exact-SHA Dev.app smoke; no real login or confirmed account was used.
